propositions: The cache-ineffective warning fires on prompts below the 4096-token cache floor, where zero cache read/write is the correct and expected result.
The warning cannot distinguish a model that fails to cache from a prompt too small to be cacheable.
A single rebar review-plan run emits roughly twenty benign warnings, causing alarm fatigue on the signal meant to catch silent cache cost bleed.
The warning contradicts the run's own aggregate telemetry, which shows cache_write_tokens > 0 for calls above the floor while smaller calls warn caching had no effect.
The CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS constant is defined only in pass1.py and must be shared with structured_run.py rather than duplicated as a second literal.
The warning should be gated on input_tokens >= the cache floor so it fires only where caching could have worked but did not.
